data.one_liner: Rust‑like Option and Result types for safer Dart code.
data.what_it_does: Provides sealed Option and Result classes that model nullable values and error handling similar to Rust. Includes functional helpers like match, when, and async redirection utilities.
use_when: You want explicit handling of nulls and errors without using exceptions
You need exhaustive pattern‑matching with sealed classes
You prefer functional‑style APIs for error propagation
avoid_when: Simple try/catch is sufficient and you don't need extra types
You are looking for code‑generation or serialization helpers
You need a full functional programming library rather than just Option/Result
strengths: Sealed classes enable exhaustive pattern matching
Rich API with sync and async helpers
weaknesses: Limited to Option/Result; no broader FP utilities
May increase learning curve for developers unfamiliar with Rust concepts
